text: Rows containing extreme outliers removed using 3 x interquartile range (IQR) rule applied morphology feature.
code: cols_to_check <- 12:41 outlier_indices <- list()  for (col in cols_to_check) {   x <- data_logtransformed[[col]]   if (!is.numeric(x)) next    Q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)   Q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)   IQR_val <- Q3 - Q1    lower_bound <- Q1 - 3 * IQR_val   upper_bound <- Q3 + 3 * IQR_val    outlier_indices[[col]] <- which(x < lower_bound | x > upper_bound) }  all_outliers <- unique(unlist(outlier_indices)) df_filtered <- data_logtransformed[-all_outliers, ]  dim(data_logtransformed) dim(df_filtered)

ColorByCluster needs one .csv file per image: named name original image starting string (.tif extension needed), files must share starting string; first column empty header ascending numbers; column named Cluster; column named ID matching single-cell ROI labels; column named Region names analyzed regions, full_brain regions provided. what: Cluster percentages at the animal level
title: MicrogliaMorphology Pipeline 2
text: animal biological replicate. Example question: across clusters, cluster membership change 2xLPS? stats_cluster.animal() fits generalized linear mixed model beta distribution (suitable percentages proportions bounded 0 1) using glmmTMB package. output includes model fit check DHARMa package, uses simulation create scaled (quantile) residuals; two DHARMa plots output[[4]]. See DHARMa vignette interpret . model cluster percentage function Cluster Treatment within one brain region (CA1). AnimalID random effect animal contributes several cluster percentages. first post hoc compares treatments (PBS vs. 2xLPS) within cluster using Sidak correction. second tests treatment effect collapsing across clusters. Repeat brain region, include region factor model.  Extract ANOVA post hoc results save csv:
code: cp_CA1 <- cp %>% filter(Region == "CA1")  stats.testing <- stats_cluster.animal(   cp_CA1,   "percentage ~ Cluster * treatment + (1|AnimalID)",   "~treatment|Cluster",   "~treatment",   "sidak" )  # check the model stats.testing[[4]]  # DHARMa model check anova <- stats.testing[[1]] anova$Region <- "CA1" write.csv(anova, "CA1_ANOVA_kmeansclusters.csv")  # post hoc 1: PBS vs. LPS within each cluster posthoc1 <- stats.testing[[2]] posthoc1$correction <- "sidak" posthoc1$Region <- "CA1" write.csv(posthoc1, "CA1_PBSvsLPS_posthoc_Sidak_kmeansclusters.csv")  # post hoc 2: treatment effect across clusters posthoc2 <- stats.testing[[3]] posthoc2$correction <- "sidak" posthoc2$Region <- "CA1" write.csv(posthoc2, "CA1_treatment_posthoc_Sidak.csv")
